--- header_pre ---
#include <stddef.h>
#if defined(__APPLE__)
#include <OpenGL/gl.h>
#include <OpenGL/glu.h>
#include <GLUT/glut.h>
#else
#define GL_GLEXT_PROTOTYPES
#include <GL/gl.h>
#include <GL/glext.h>
#include <GL/glu.h>
#include <GL/freeglut.h>
#endif
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- gl_vector_helpers ---
/* C89 replacements for C99 compound GL literals. */

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat3(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat3_buf[3];
  repl_glfloat3_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[2] = c;
  return repl_glfloat3_buf;
}

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat4(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c, GLfloat d) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat4_buf[4];
  repl_glfloat4_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[2] = c;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[3] = d;
  return repl_glfloat4_buf;
}
--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -3.5000f);   // @camera dist
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera rx
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera ry
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.0000f, -0.0000f);   // @camera pan
--- header_post ---
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source ---
  // Traveling ripple ring: for + fmod + conditional deformation
  // ang is this segment's angle around the ring, named because all three
  // lines below need it; bump is the radial swell inside the ripple arc,
  // applied to x and y alike so the ring bulges outward, not sideways.
  static float phase, width, delta, amp, ang, bump, x, y;
  static float n = 400; // ring segment count

  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);
  glLightModeli(GL_LIGHT_MODEL_TWO_SIDE, GL_TRUE);
  glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SPECULAR, (GLfloat[]){0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1});
  glMaterialf(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SHININESS, 30);
  amp = 0.1 * sin(t * TAU);
  phase = fmod(t / 3, TAU);
  width = PI / 8;
  glBegin(GL_LINE_LOOP);
    for(i, 0, n) {
      glColor3f(0.15, 0.55, 1);
      ang = TAU * i / n;
      x = cos(ang);
      y = sin(ang);
      delta = fmod(ang - phase + TAU, TAU);
      if(delta < width) {
        glColor3f(1, 0.85, 0.15);
        bump = amp * sin(delta * TAU / width);
        x = x + bump * x;
        y = y + bump * y;
      }
      glVertex3f(x, y, 0);
    }
  glEnd();
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
